description: ⚡ ACTION: Send SMS message to any phone number worldwide. Requires a Twilio phone number as sender. Returns message SID and delivery status. $0.0083/SMS US outbound (Twilio)

body.description: SMS message text (max 1600 chars, splits into multiple segments if >160)

from.description: Sender phone number — must be a Twilio number you own (e.g. "+15551234567")

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (e.g. "+14155551234")

name: phone.twilio.sms

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Send SMS (Twilio)
